description: Defines the XPUStream class and related functions for managing SYCL queues and streams in the c10::xpu namespace, including stream creation, querying, synchronization, and external queue interoperability.

classes.name: XPUStream
classes.description: A wrapper around c10::Stream representing a SYCL queue for asynchronous XPU tasks, with methods for stream management, querying, synchronization, and packing/unpacking.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two XPUStream objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two XPUStream objects.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type, which is XPU.

methods.name: device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with the stream.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the full Device object associated with the stream.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if all tasks in the stream have completed.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Blocks until all enqueued tasks in the stream are completed.

methods.name: priority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of the stream.

methods.name: pack3
methods.description: Serializes the stream into a struct for packing.

methods.name: unpack3
methods.description: Deserializes a stream from packed fields.
